items.title: Natty Dominique Interview, 1958-05-31
items.q: I went to school with Lizzie Miles. Her name was Lizzie Landry. Her and I was in the same room.

ctx.x: Yeah, it's like lightning away against the ring. Yeah. There's a couple of other people here I was going to ask about. One briefly about Lizzie Miles.

I went to school with Lizzie Miles. Her name was Lizzie Landry. Her and I was in the same room. And I hope when you go to New Orleans, tell them you saw Dominic Dillacone play that went to Mary Lee's school with you.
